name: Hermes Drops claim
description: Claim CashToken rewards from a Hermes Drops pool with a Merkle proof; a receipt NFT records the claimed total.

claimer.name: Claimer
claimer.description: An address in the reward tree claiming what it has earned.

claim.name: First claim
claim.description: Claim $(<payout>) reward units for account $(<accountId>) (first claim: sets the account bit, mints the receipt).

claimAgain.name: Claim again
claimAgain.description: Claim the difference since the last claim; the old receipt is burned and a new one minted.

shardInput.name: Pool shard
shardInput.description: The shard holding this account’s claim bit and the active root.

shardAgainInput.name: Pool shard

receiptInput.name: Previous receipt
receiptInput.description: The receipt NFT from the last claim (burned).

shardOutput.name: Pool shard
shardOutput.description: Shard continues with the updated claim bitmap.

receiptOutput.name: Receipt
receiptOutput.description: Receipt NFT: account and claimed total.

vaultScript.name: Drops vault covenant
